info.title: ForgeMesh ShopScout
info.description: Local catalog connector and shipping calculator. Catalog access requires configuration; monitoring remains planned. No payments or purchases.
info.x-guidance: Start with /v1/capabilities. Search products, then refresh exact variants and compare item prices. Shipping comparison uses supplied rules, not live carrier rates. Valid empty searches are charged; upstream errors are not settled. No automatic purchases. Planned operations return 501 and are never charged. MCP requires a separate payer and does not auto-pay.

post.summary: Search Shopify catalog products by query, destination and currency. Returns products whose title, seller, type or tags share a term with the query; unrelated catalog suggestions are dropped, and a search with nothing related answers 404 no_match without charge.

200.description: Source-attributed products or offer comparison; unknown costs remain null

402.description: Payment Required: inspect PAYMENT-REQUIRED and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

404.description: no_match: nothing in the catalog matches the query terms / requested variant ids. Not charged.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded before payment or computation
